# agentic-write

Route copy jobs to Claude, GPT, or Workers AI.

Keywords: copywriting, llm-router, captions, agentic-suite, claude-code, codex, cli, mcp.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-write".
- CLI: agentic-write summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-write mcp, then call summarize_text.
